<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="The Gauri Archive — an illustrated personal archive of medicine, research, culture, writing, motherhood and experience.">
<title>The Gauri Archive</title>
<style>
:root {
  --burgundy: #9e0124;
  --deep-burgundy: #6f0b24;
  --ivory: #faf5eb;
  --paper: #fffaf2;
  --ink: #30221f;
  --muted: #836f68;
  --line: #dfd1c4;
  --blush: #f8ebdd;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  background: var(--ivory);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
}
button { font: inherit; }
.site-header {
  padding: 22px clamp(22px, 6vw, 92px);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}
.site-header strong { color: var(--burgundy); font-size: 1.02rem; }
.site-header span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
.hero {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 73px);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 8px 8px 40px;
}
.scene {
  position: relative;
  width: min(100%, 96vw);
  height: calc(100vh - 96px);
  min-height: 620px;
  max-height: 920px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.whole-fruit, .cross-section {
  position: absolute;
  width: 88%;
  max-width: 760px;
}
.whole-fruit {
  z-index: 2;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 500ms, transform 700ms;
}
.whole-fruit img, .cross-section img { display: block; width: 100%; }
.whole-fruit:hover { transform: scale(1.035) rotate(-1deg); }
.whole-fruit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--burgundy); outline-offset: 10px; }
.cross-section {
  z-index: 1;
  width: 72%;
  max-width: 620px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(.35) rotate(-5deg);
  transition: opacity 800ms, transform 900ms;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.orbit {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: scale(.2);
  transition: opacity 600ms, transform 800ms;
}
.seed {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: clamp(54px, 10%, 70px);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border: 1px solid #e3b5a9;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--blush);
  padding: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateY(calc(var(--radius) * -1)) rotate(calc(var(--angle) * -1));
  transition: background 250ms, border-color 250ms, box-shadow 250ms;
}
.seed img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.seed:hover, .seed:focus-visible {
  background: #f0d3c7;
  border-color: var(--burgundy);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(158, 1, 36, .12);
  outline: none;
}
.scene.open .whole-fruit { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.25); pointer-events: none; }
.scene.open .cross-section { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(0); }
.scene.open .orbit { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
.scene.open .orbit:not(.paused) { animation: revolve 35s linear infinite; }
.scene.open .seed { animation: counter-revolve 35s linear infinite; }
.scene.open .orbit.paused, .scene.open .orbit.paused .seed { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes revolve { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes counter-revolve { to { rotate: -360deg; } }
.hint {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--burgundy);
  font-size: .9rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.controls {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 1%;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}
.control {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(250, 245, 235, .85);
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: .78rem;
}
.control:hover, .control:focus-visible { border-color: var(--burgundy); color: var(--burgundy); outline: none; }
.entry {
  width: min(100% - 32px, 620px);
  margin: 0 auto 72px;
  padding: 30px clamp(20px, 5vw, 42px) 36px;
  border-top: 1px solid #d9c3b9;
  background: rgba(255, 250, 242, .42);
}
.eyebrow { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .76rem; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.entry h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--burgundy); font-weight: normal; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 2.7rem); }
.entry p { margin: 18px 0 26px; line-height: 1.85; color: #493936; }
.back {
  border: 1px solid var(--burgundy);
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--burgundy);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.back:hover, .back:focus-visible { background: var(--burgundy); color: var(--ivory); outline: none; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .site-header { padding-inline: 22px; }
  .scene { width: 100%; min-height: 560px; }
  .whole-fruit { width: 94%; }
  .cross-section { width: 78%; }
  .seed { width: 13%; }
  .controls { right: 50%; transform: translateX(50%); bottom: -9%; }
  .hint { bottom: 4%; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="site-header">
  <strong>The Gauri Archive</strong>
</header>
<main class="hero">
  <div class="scene" id="scene">
    <button class="whole-fruit" id="openFruit" aria-label="Open the pomegranate">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="An illustrated whole pomegranate">
    </button>
    <div class="cross-section" aria-hidden="true">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
    </div>
    <div class="orbit" id="orbit" aria-label="Archive categories"></div>
    <p class="hint" id="hint">A universe within. Click to explore.</p>
    <div class="controls" aria-label="Archive controls">
      <button class="control" id="reset" type="button" hidden>Close archive</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
<section class="entry" id="entry" hidden aria-live="polite">
  <p class="eyebrow">From the archive</p>
  <h2 id="entryTitle"></h2>
  <p id="entryText"></p>
  <button class="back" id="back" type="button">← Back to the seeds</button>
</section>
<script>
const seedImage = "data:image/webp;base64,";
const seedImages = [
  "data:image/webp;base64,",
  "data:image/webp;base64,",
  "data:image/webp;base64,",
  "data:image/webp;base64,",
  "data:image/webp;base64,",
  "data:image/webp;base64,"
];
const interests = [
  { title: "Medicine", text: "Clinical learning, patient care and the questions that keep me curious." },
  { title: "Research & Innovation", text: "Research, med-tech experiments and ideas that might become something more." },
  { title: "Art, Culture & History", text: "Exploring how art, culture, history and economics shape one another." },
  { title: "Ideas & Writing", text: "Essays, opinions, observations and things I cannot stop thinking about." },
  { title: "SuperMoms", text: "Building ideas at the intersection of pregnancy, technology and care." },
  { title: "Experiences", text: "The experiences, people and moments that have shaped my journey." }
];
const scene = document.getElementById("scene");
const orbit = document.getElementById("orbit");
const entry = document.getElementById("entry");
const hint = document.getElementById("hint");
const reset = document.getElementById("reset");
function showEntry(item) {
  orbit.classList.add("paused");
  document.getElementById("entryTitle").textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById("entryText").textContent = item.text;
  entry.hidden = false;
  entry.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
}
interests.forEach(function(item, index) {
  const seed = document.createElement("button");
  seed.className = "seed";
  seed.type = "button";
  seed.setAttribute("aria-label", item.title);
  seed.style.setProperty("--angle", (index * 360 / interests.length) + "deg");
  seed.style.setProperty("--radius", "clamp(100px, 34%, 215px)");
  seed.innerHTML = '<img src="' + seedImages[index] + '" alt="">';
  seed.addEventListener("click", function() { showEntry(item); });
  orbit.appendChild(seed);
});
document.getElementById("openFruit").addEventListener("click", function() {
  scene.classList.add("open");
  reset.hidden = false;
  hint.textContent = "Choose a seed to explore.";
});
function closeArchive() {
  entry.hidden = true;
  scene.classList.remove("open");
  orbit.classList.remove("paused");
  reset.hidden = true;
  hint.textContent = "A universe within. Click to explore.";
  document.getElementById("openFruit").focus();
}
document.getElementById("back").addEventListener("click", function() {
  entry.hidden = true;
  orbit.classList.remove("paused");
});
reset.addEventListener("click", closeArchive);
</script>
</body>
</html>
